newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF sale terms set in early Jan.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF sale terms set in early Jan.

text.p: The French government will decide on the terms of a privatisation of Thomson-CSF in early January, a source at the prime minister's office said on Thursday.
"The decision will not be taken before January," the source said.

The government wants to sell its 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF in the early part of 1997, separate from loss- making consumer electronics firm Thomson Multimedia, to speed the privatisation of the Thomson SA electronics group.
The source said the delay of the decision, which had been expected either Friday or early next week, was due to the approaching Christmas and New Year's holidays and the departure of staff.

The government on December 4 suspended the privatisation through private placement of Thomson SA because an independent privatisation commission did not approve of the sale of Thomson Multimedia to South Korean firm Daewoo Electronics.
